key: Counting votes on paper slips after a college election
name: ch10_vote_slips_sort_count
alt: Students count college election votes by sorting paper slips into piles by name, counting each pile, lining the piles up tallest first and announcing the top five.
scene: A college seminar hall the evening after a student election, a long wooden table under tube lights, an empty ballot box tipped on its side at the far left with a heap of folded paper slips spilling out. The picture reads left to right as four simple steps along the table. First, two students (a young woman in a kurti with a dupatta, a young man in a checked shirt) pick slips from the heap and drop each one onto a pile for that candidate, every pile topped by a small coloured card with a candidate face icon, no tally sheet anywhere. Second, a bespectacled student in a hoodie counts one pile with his finger, a small number tag "42" clipped to it. Third, the piles stand in a row arranged from tallest to shortest, like a bar chart made of paper, with a curved arrow showing them being reordered. Fourth, at the far right end, the student union secretary in a white kurta stands on a low stool holding a sheet and announcing the first five piles, which carry little ribbon badges, while the sixth and smaller piles are left in shadow. Thin arrows join the four steps like a pipeline. Evening light through tall windows, posters and bunting on the wall, excited but orderly mood. Labels: "SORT" over the slip piles, "COUNT" over the counted pile, and "TOP 5" over the announcer.

key: Writing a PIN code on a letter. You don
name: ch10_pin_code_letter_routing
alt: A woman writes only the address and PIN code on a letter while the post decides the route, moving letters to a spare van when one van breaks down.
scene: A wide illustration read left to right. Far left, on a verandah of a small house, a middle-aged woman in a cotton sari sits at a low table writing an address on an envelope, her pen finishing a six-digit PIN code "560001" in large clear numbers; she looks calm and is not looking at any map. A red cylindrical post box stands at her gate. From the box, a dotted route line runs to the right through a simple landscape: a sorting office with a conveyor, then a choice of roads, a railway line with a small mail train and a highway with red mail vans; the letter is drawn as a small white envelope travelling along. In the middle of the highway one red van has broken down with its bonnet up, steam rising and a small warning triangle, while a postman in khaki calmly carries the sack of letters across to a second red van parked behind it, a curved arrow showing the hand-over. At the far right, a postman on a bicycle delivers the same envelope to a happy young man at a house door in a distant city. The woman never sees any of this middle part, shown by a soft cloud covering the route above her. Bright late-morning light, reassuring mood. Labels: "ONLY THE ADDRESS" above the woman, and "REROUTED" above the broken van.
